lines.speaker: recruiter_sana
lines.text: Eighty-four years. Say that again, slowly, and don't soften it.

lines.speaker: recruiter_sana
lines.text: Then there's no list. There can't be. You can't recruit people to a year — you can only tell them the date and watch them go home and sit down with it, and I've got about three hundred names in this book.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: You told her the truth. It was the truth. I am only saying that both of those can be so at once, and that you will be carrying the second one for a while.
